# PR #3384: Patch: follow-up to #3367 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #3377

## What changed

The spot-check found five inspect sheets that still closed by a text "Close" button. Each now closes by `DialogClose`, the same ✕ at the top right that every other dialog uses (R3221000). The five are: a card's touch sheet (`InspectSheet`), a pile's list (`CardListSheet`), a face-down card (`FaceDownSheet`), the Stack's wheel (`StackSheet`) and `HeroInspect`.

- **What stays the same:** each sheet keeps its testid (`inspect-close` or `hero-inspect-close`), its focus on open and its Tab order, because the ✕ is still the sheet's last element. It also keeps its swipe and long-press guard, because `modal.dismissProps` is spread on the ✕.
- **A pile's list:** the row of answers is now drawn only when a face is opened large. Without this, the grid view would show an empty, bordered row once Close left it.
- **Room for the ✕ (CSS, spacing tokens only):**
  - `inspect.css`:
    - the sheet body starts under the ✕;
    - on a phone held sideways, the right column of the card's sheet keeps clear of it, and the old rule that put Close in column 2 is gone;
    - the pile list's header is as tall as the ✕ and stops short of it.
  - `wheel.css`: the same for the Stack sheet's header.
- **R3221000:** the "keep their text Close" exception is replaced by a sentence saying these sheets take the same ✕. `cards` now includes issue #3377, and `proven_in` lists the two new proving files.
- **Docs:** the `apps/web/README.md` and `Dialog.tsx` comments are updated. So is a comment in `store.ts` that said Close sits at the foot of a dialog.
- **Tests:**
  - `dialogs.test.ts` gets a new check that fails on any element whose only child is `Close` or `t("Close")`. Its list of files that must use `DialogClose` grows from 2 to 7.
  - New `sheetClose.test.tsx`: the four card sheets each have a ✕ with class `dialog__close`, named "Close", focused, last in the sheet, and calling `onClose`. A pile's list has no row of answers until a face is opened.
  - `emotes.test.tsx` gets the same check for the hero's view.
- **Patch fragment:** a new pending fragment, `crates/cards/patches/pending/the-card-pile-stack-and-hero-sheets-close-by-the-same-as.json`, claims `visual: true`, with a player note.

## How I tested it

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` built.
- **Unit tests:**
  - The plan's vitest set, plus `surfaces`, `typescale`, `motion` and `src/emotes/`: 31 files, 438 tests passed.
  - The harness's web command (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …`): 246 files passed; 5059 tests passed and 74 were skipped. None of the skips is in this change.
- **The new tests fail on `main`:** I put `main`'s five sheet files back for one run, then restored mine. All 8 new or extended R3221000 tests failed. The text-Close check listed exactly the five files.
- **Typecheck and lint:** `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `tsc -p e2e/cypress/component/tsconfig.json` and eslint on the changed paths were all clean.
- **Repo checks:** `cargo fmt --check` passed. `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check` passed. `cargo test -p jackioh-tools -- patches spec fragment`: 110 passed.
- **classify:** `classify --base origin/main --claims` with nothing committed sees no change and prints `Internal`. To get a real answer I classified a throwaway commit object; no branch, HEAD or index moved. The result: `kind: cards`, `tier: micro`, `visual: true`, `problems: []`.
- **Cypress component specs:** `emotes-layout` passed 60/60, and `stack-wheel-and-sweeps` and `practice-table` passed.
- **Overlap check (instead of the ui-walkthrough):** a temporary Cypress spec, deleted afterwards, mounted all five sheets, with a long card and a pile with a face opened as extra cases. It ran at 390x844, 360x740, 1280x720, 844x390, 667x375 and 768x1024.
  - It checked that the ✕ sits 8px inside each sheet's top right corner and that no text, face, grid, wheel, portrait or row of answers lies under it: 42/42 passed.
  - With `main`'s CSS, 16 of the 42 failed, so the CSS changes are needed.

## Red check

`card-sizes.cy.tsx` fails 1 of 9 tests: "#3341 at phone 390x844 … a field card is at least the budget's card", 86 against 89.5. It also fails exactly the same way locally with every file I changed under `apps/web` and `e2e` put back to `main`'s, so this change does not cause it. I have no CI run on `main` to link. It is a component spec, not one of the harness's checks.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Dropped plan step 8 (`portrait.css`).** The overlap check showed the hero's ✕ already sits in the panel's corner in the sideways layout, without that rule (an absolutely positioned grid child's `grid-column: 2` ends at the padding edge). The rule did nothing, so I left it out. Rejected: keeping it as an explicit statement of intent.
- **Hero view ✕ at 1280x720 with a mouse.** The Cypress R1330 test checked 44px at every viewport; it now checks 44px on touch viewports and that the button is the shared ✕ everywhere, and its title says so.
